statement: A conversion grants only the actions 7.x decided: an ALLOW of every 7.x action (the pattern `*`, `all` without methods, a `path` array holding `*`, or an array or composite holding one of them) is `http:*`, never `*`, so no converted ALLOW reaches a control-plane action (`cosec:*`) or the action of a check in code; a DENY of every 7.x action stays `*`, and the report records it (C7).
properties: migrate:ConvertedReachPropertyTest#no converted deployment permits an action outside http
guards: migrate:AllActionReachTest#a global allow of every action converts to no control-plane action
migrate:AllActionReachTest#an attachable allow of every action converts to no control-plane action
migrate:AllActionReachTest#a global allow of every action gives the platform tenant no control of the platform
migrate:AllActionReachTest#a DENY of every action still refuses everything, and is recorded
migrate:AllActionReachTest#a converted allow of every action publishes nothing through the control plane
migrate:MatcherTranslatorTest#every action is http star in an ALLOW and star in a DENY
